purpose: Test distinct event hypotheses and remove composite loss profiles only when the event family has at least 200 resolved 2023 trades.
time: MT5 server bar-open time; decisions occur at M15 close
execution: M15 ATR14 risk, SL 1R, TP 1.5R, horizon 720 minutes, exact M1 entry, same-M1 SL priority, one open position per family

families.B_BREAKOUT_LONG: H1 and H4 uptrend; M15 close above prior20 high; positive body over 0.3 ATR; close location above 0.7
families.B_BREAKOUT_SHORT: H1 and H4 downtrend; M15 close below prior20 low; negative body below -0.3 ATR; close location below 0.3
families.C_FAILED_BREAK_LONG: M15 pierces prior20 low and closes back above it; lower wick exceeds absolute body; RSI below45
families.C_FAILED_BREAK_SHORT: M15 pierces prior20 high and closes back below it; upper wick exceeds absolute body; RSI above55
families.F_TREND_ACCEL_LONG: H1 normalized EMA gap above0.3 and rising; M15 close above prior8 high; M5 four-bar return positive
families.F_TREND_ACCEL_SHORT: H1 normalized EMA gap below-0.3 and falling; M15 close below prior8 low; M5 four-bar return negative
